source_cards.title: Измерение SpO2
source_cards.summary: При ВП рекомендовано измерять SpO2 для выявления гипоксемии.
source_cards.formal_contract: Scope: age>=18, ward=therapy, severity=nonsevere, visible diagnosis value=confirmed_cap. Otherwise not_applicable, no action. Only events at or after first confirmed diagnosis. Explicit rule exception overrides: unknown, action specialist_review. Missing record is not proof that care was omitted. A visible spo2 record: met, no action. No record: unknown, action measure_spo2. Do not grade the measured percentage or infer a diagnosis from it.
source_cards.approval: Исследовательская формализация; врачом и преподавателем не утверждена

source_cards.title: Срок назначения антибиотика
source_cards.summary: В стационаре системный антибиотик при установленной ВП назначают как можно раньше, не позднее 4 ч после диагноза.
source_cards.formal_contract: Scope: age>=18, ward=therapy, severity=nonsevere, visible diagnosis value=confirmed_cap. Otherwise not_applicable, no action. Only events at or after first confirmed diagnosis. Explicit rule exception overrides: unknown, action specialist_review. Missing record is not proof that care was omitted. Use antibiotic_order, NOT antibiotic_start. First order <=4h after diagnosis: met; >4h: attention. No order and elapsed<=4h: pending; no order and elapsed>4h: unknown. For every non-met status action review_antibiotic_order. Never infer an order from a start record. Dose and drug choice are outside this rule.
source_cards.approval: Исследовательская формализация; врачом и преподавателем не утверждена

source_cards.title: Оценка ответа на лечение
source_cards.summary: После начала лечения оценку эффективности и безопасности проводят через 48–72 ч; учитывают клиническую динамику.
source_cards.formal_contract: Scope: age>=18, ward=therapy, severity=nonsevere, visible diagnosis value=confirmed_cap. Otherwise not_applicable, no action. Only events at or after first confirmed diagnosis. Explicit rule exception overrides: unknown, action specialist_review. Missing record is not proof that care was omitted. Use first antibiotic_start, NOT order. No start: unknown, action clarify_treatment_start. A reassessment 48<=hours_from_start<=72: met. Without such assessment: elapsed<=72 pending; elapsed>72 with late reassessment attention; elapsed>72 without late reassessment unknown. Early assessments <48h do not satisfy the interval. Action for non-met: elapsed<48 schedule_reassessment; otherwise assess_response. Absence of documentation is not proof of no assessment.
source_cards.approval: Исследовательская формализация; врачом и преподавателем не утверждена

source_cards.title: Пересмотр тактики при ухудшении
source_cards.summary: При прогрессировании симптомов или осложнениях требуется пересмотреть тактику, тяжесть состояния и необходимость перевода в ОРИТ.
source_cards.formal_contract: Scope: age>=18, ward=therapy, severity=nonsevere, visible diagnosis value=confirmed_cap. Otherwise not_applicable, no action. Only events at or after first confirmed diagnosis. Explicit rule exception overrides: unknown, action specialist_review. Missing record is not proof that care was omitted. Consider reassessment value=worsening only after a visible antibiotic_start. No such event: not_applicable. Any treatment_review at or after the latest worsening: met; otherwise attention and action review_treatment. No invented grace period. This formal trigger covers only explicit worsening, not every clinical sign of treatment failure; unchanged alone does not trigger it.
source_cards.approval: Исследовательская формализация; врачом и преподавателем не утверждена

recommendations.explanation: Прошло более 72 часов с начала лечения; требуется оценка эффективности и безопасности.
